summary: Keep hypotheses, evidence, negative results, and claims explicitly separated.
instructions: Freeze the question, comparison, metrics, and decision rule before using results to select a route.
Label sources as retrieved-and-verified, retrieved-unverified, model-recalled, or user-provided.
Preserve negative and ambiguous results; do not silently change protocols after seeing outcomes.
Every headline claim must resolve to an experiment, artifact, source, or explicit unresolved gap.
